summary:
### TL;DR
- A quiet day: no GitHub Changelog entries about Actions or security.
- No breaking changes, deprecations, or new security capabilities.
- One minor docs fix: the workflow template instructions now use the current commit button label ([source](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/c4323dfd6a4921c12c136a82cc5907d6f8a4c455)).

### Action required
Nothing this time.

### Security improvements
Nothing this time.

### Docs changes worth reading
- **Using workflow templates: corrected UI label.** The step for committing a new workflow from a template now says to click **Commit changes...**. It previously said **Start commit**, which no longer matches the UI. The surrounding guidance is unchanged: store any secrets the template references (e.g. `${{ secrets.npm_token }}`) as repository secrets, then commit to the default branch or open a pull request. ([docs](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/use-workflow-templates), [commit](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/c4323dfd6a4921c12c136a82cc5907d6f8a4c455))

*Skipped:* a wording-only style edit ("Click on" → "Click") in [View job condition logs](https://github.com/github/docs/commit/496096e9913e59b2afd4c6e3362c42f12fe59361).

docs.title: Align with style guide by using click instead of click on in job condition logs (#46953)
